summary.text: Joe Schmick is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 9-Position 2, which he has represented since 2007, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He faces Karina Wallace (D) in the general election, and his profession is listed as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Schmick took office in 2007 and has served 19 years in the seat.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Rural Development, Agriculture, and Natural Resources; Appropriations; and Health Care and Wellness committees.
In the August 4, 2026 primary he received 64.4% of the vote to Wallace's 35.4%.
